findings.summary: Attachments panel opens with no close button inside the panel itself
findings.detail: The Attachments bar pops out below the editor header when its toggle is clicked, but the popped-out surface contains no ×/Close control. A user looking at the bar has no visible way to dismiss it; the only exits are re-clicking the small toggle button above (undiscoverable) — Escape does NOT close it.
findings.repro: open a note → click the Attachments button in the editor header

findings.summary: Insert-image dialog asks the user to "paste a data:image URL" with a base64 placeholder
findings.detail: The second field literally says "…or paste a data:image URL" with placeholder "data:image/png;base64,…". A normal user reads this as the app asking them for blobs/encoded data. Dialog text captured: Insert image Choose a local image file …or paste a data:image URL Alt text (describe the image) Caption (optional — editable under the image) Cancel Insert
findings.repro: open a note → toolbar Image button

findings.summary: Image file picker excludes HEIC/HEIF photos (iPhone default camera format)
findings.detail: The file input accept filter is "image/png,image/jpeg,image/gif,image/webp,image/bmp,image/svg+xml" — HEIC/HEIF photos are greyed out in the OS picker, so "it does not take pictures from the PC" for anyone whose photos are in the modern default format.
findings.repro: open Insert image → click Choose a local image file → try to select an .heic photo
